title: From ionic-liquid@metal-organic framework composites to heteroatom-decorated large-surface area carbons: superior CO2 and H2 uptake.

functional_groups: pyridinic N (398.4 eV), amidic/pyrrolic N (400.1 eV), quaternary N (401.4 eV)
source_location: Main text p.6500-6501 (H2 paragraph) and Table S1 (SI p.S5), H2 uptake at 77 K, 1 atm; Fig. 5a
notes: printed pressure 1 atm = 1.01325 bar; printed wt% 1.7 and 183 cm3(STP)/g. BET range: 0.05-0.20 (P/P0, SI p.S1); N2 at 77 K; area and pore volume from Table S1 (column 'Pore volume', type not stated, stored as total).
